canonical.title: A11y & primitive foundations: what MUI, shadcn/ui, Mantine and Base UI actually inherit in 2026

parent.title: Which React UI component kit should itenium-ui adopt in 2026?

siblings.title: MUI vs shadcn/ui vs Mantine vs Base UI: the 2026 maturity and governance baseline
siblings.summary: The four kits are not the same category: MUI and Mantine are batteries-included libraries, shadcn/ui is a code registry, Base UI is primitives — and as of July 2026 shadcn/ui defaults to Base UI, making MUI's own primitive layer the de-facto industry standard.

siblings.title: Styling engine and Tailwind 4 interop: which React component kit survives the cascade
siblings.summary: Tailwind 4 puts every utility inside a cascade layer, so any kit that ships unlayered CSS silently outranks it — which reframes the MUI/shadcn/Mantine/Base UI choice as a question about where each kit's styles land in the layer stack.

siblings.title: Admin-console component coverage: what MUI, shadcn/ui, Mantine and Base UI actually ship in 2026
siblings.summary: Only Mantine covers a CRUD admin console in-box with a single gap (the data grid); MUI's coverage is real but the grid features you actually need are paywalled; shadcn now defaults to Base UI, making them one choice, not two.

siblings.title: Theming, tokens and brand reach: MUI vs shadcn/ui vs Mantine vs Base UI in 2026
siblings.summary: On a Tailwind-4 monorepo the token substrate decides the kit: shadcn/ui and Base UI put brand tokens directly in @theme, while MUI and Mantine keep a JS theme object as the source of truth.

siblings.title: Nx 21 build ergonomics: which UI kit survives a shared itenium-ui library
siblings.summary: shadcn/ui's copy-in model does work in a shared Nx library, but only if you own the plumbing: a components.json in the lib, a private registry for updates, and Tailwind 4 @source globs across the boundary.

sources.title: shadcn/ui changelog — Base UI is the default (Jul 2026)
sources.claim: Base UI became the default primitive layer in shadcn/ui in July 2026; Radix is not deprecated and remains available via the -b radix flag; new projects pick Base UI over Radix 2:1.

sources.title: InfoQ — Base UI 1.0: accessible React primitives
sources.claim: Base UI 1.0 shipped Dec 11 2025 with 35 accessible components, built by engineers from Radix, Floating UI and Material UI; maintainers reject the 'Radix successor' framing; package renamed to @base-ui/react.

sources.title: GitHub — mui/base-ui
sources.claim: Base UI repo: 10,335 stars, 7 open accessibility-labelled issues, actively pushed July 2026.

sources.title: GitHub — radix-ui/primitives
sources.claim: Radix Primitives is still maintained by WorkOS; 19,064 stars, repo pushed 13 Jul 2026, ~10 open accessibility-titled issues.

sources.title: GitHub — shadcn-ui/ui
sources.claim: shadcn/ui repo: 119,064 stars; 6 open accessibility-titled issues.

sources.title: GitHub — mantinedev/mantine
sources.claim: Mantine repo: 31,424 stars, only 35 open issues total and 0 open accessibility-titled issues.

sources.title: GitHub — adobe/react-spectrum
sources.claim: React Spectrum / React Aria repo: 15,662 stars, 33 open accessibility-labelled issues.

sources.title: GitHub — chakra-ui/ark
sources.claim: Ark UI repo: 5,282 stars, 12 open issues total.

sources.title: GitHub — mui/material-ui
sources.claim: Material UI repo: 98,582 stars and 88 open accessibility-labelled issues — the largest a11y backlog of the kits compared.

sources.title: React Aria — Quality & testing
sources.claim: React Aria publishes a named screen-reader test matrix (VoiceOver macOS/iOS, JAWS, NVDA, TalkBack) but claims no WCAG conformance level and publishes no VPAT.

sources.title: Mantine Help — Are Mantine components accessible?
sources.claim: Mantine tests interactive components with jest-axe and manually with VoiceOver only; explicitly disclaims full app-level accessibility.

sources.title: Base UI — Accessibility overview
sources.claim: Base UI claims WAI-ARIA APG adherence and automatic focus management, and unspecified 'broad spectrum' screen-reader testing, but names no test matrix and claims no WCAG level.

sources.title: material-ui#14187 — Create ADA compliance documentation (open since Jan 2019)
sources.claim: The request for MUI ADA/WCAG compliance documentation has been open since January 2019 with no maintainer position and no VPAT produced.

sources.title: GreatFrontEnd — Top headless UI libraries for React in 2026
sources.claim: Independent 2026 comparison calls React Aria the most accessibility-rigorous headless library, and notes Radix updates have slowed for complex components while Base UI iterates faster.

sources.title: TheFrontKit — shadcn/ui accessibility audit 2026
sources.claim: A 2026 audit (VoiceOver/Safari, NVDA/Firefox, axe DevTools, Lighthouse, WAVE) found 34/48 shadcn components pass WCAG 2.2 AA, 9 need minor fixes, 5 have real gaps; the default focus ring measures 2.4:1, below the 3:1 non-text contrast threshold.

sources.title: MUI blog — 2026 and beyond
sources.claim: MUI's 2026 roadmap: Base UI is the major focus; new components (NumberField, MenuBar, PreviewCard) are built on Base UI, but Material UI is not being rebuilt on top of it.

sources.title: Software Engineering Daily — Radix UI with Chance Strickland
sources.claim: Radix has a named active maintainer, Chance Strickland, employed by WorkOS (Nov 2025).

sources.title: npm — radix-ui
sources.claim: Radix is actively released in 2026: radix-ui 1.6.2 published 6 Jul 2026 with 1.6.3 release candidates through 13 Jul 2026; ~10.2M weekly downloads for the meta package and 66.8M for @radix-ui/react-dialog.

sources.title: npm — react-aria
sources.claim: react-aria has ~7.4M weekly npm downloads (Jul 2026).

sources.title: npm — @base-ui/react
sources.claim: @base-ui/react is at 1.6.0 (published 18 Jun 2026) with ~6.2M weekly downloads; the legacy @base-ui-components/react package has collapsed to ~0.4M.

sources.title: npm — @mui/material
sources.claim: @mui/material 9.2.0 depends on Popper, react-transition-group, @mui/system and @mui/utils — no Base UI and no Radix, confirming MUI Core implements its own accessibility behaviour; ~7.8M weekly downloads.

sources.title: npm — @mantine/core
sources.claim: @mantine/core 9.4.1 depends only on @floating-ui/react, clsx, react-number-format, react-remove-scroll and type-fest — all widget behaviour and ARIA wiring is self-implemented; ~1.6M weekly downloads.

sources.title: radix-ui/primitives#2317 — Publicis Sapient accessibility audit (35 issues, open since Aug 2023)
sources.claim: Publicis Sapient's Accessibility Center of Excellence audited Radix across VoiceOver/Safari (macOS+iOS), NVDA/Firefox and TalkBack/Chrome, found 35 accessibility issues, and the tracking issue filed Aug 2023 is still open.

sources.title: Ark UI — About
sources.claim: Ark UI provides 40+ headless components across React/Vue/Solid/Svelte, every component backed by a Zag.js finite state machine; ~0.93M weekly npm downloads.

sources.title: MUI X Tree View — Accessibility
sources.claim: MUI states WCAG Level AA as an aspiration ('what we aim to support'), per-component, rather than a conformance claim.

sources.title: shadcn/ui changelog — Base UI docs land (Jan 2026)
sources.claim: shadcn shipped full Base UI documentation in January 2026 and rebuilt every component example for both Radix and Base UI before making Base UI the default in July.
